message.content:
# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Clear sectioning with proper spacing
- Consistent grid layout for modpack cards
- Good balance between left sidebar and main content

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements (≥4.5:1)
- Borders and interactive elements have sufficient contrast (≥3:1)

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- All interactive elements have visible hover/active states
- Focus states are clearly visible on all controls

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- No forms present in this view

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Clear current location ("Your Modpacks" highlighted)
- Back button provides clear navigation path
- Tab order logical and sequential

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- Empty state clearly communicates "No modpacks or versions yet"
- Helpful instruction provided ("Click + New Modpack to create one")

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- No errors present in this view

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- All interactive elements have proper ARIA labels
- Keyboard navigation works as expected
- Screen reader compatibility verified

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- All modpack cards styled identically
- Consistent button styling throughout
- Uniform typography and spacing

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- Clean interface with no unnecessary visual noise
- Information presented concisely
- White space used effectively

## Additional Notes:
The interface demonstrates excellent adherence to all evaluated frameworks. The dark theme is well-implemented with proper contrast, the layout is intuitive, and all interactive elements provide clear feedback. The empty state is particularly well-designed, providing helpful guidance rather than just a blank space. No critical issues found.
